description: Plan mutation testing and return the plan envelope: each mutant's id, position, operator, disposition, and static test files, plus a source_sha256 per file. Scope: changed code by default, or `all`, or `paths`. This tool never runs tests. Running the mutants needs the CLI command `fallow mutation`, which executes the project's tests, so ask your host first. On a Rust root, it runs `cargo fallow mutants --list` for one `package`, by default all of it.

all.description: Plan every source file instead of the changed code.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

changed_since.description:
Base ref for the default changed-code scope. Omitted: the base is
detected as for `audit`.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

function_scope.description:
Plan every mutant of each function that holds a changed line. Omitted:
the `mutation.functionScope` config key, else the changed lines only.

max_mutants.description:
Maximum number of mutants to plan; the rest are `pending`. A run fills
the limit with covered mutants, so it can also run a `pending` one.

mutants_per_line.description:
Keep at most this many mutants on each line; the rest are `pending`
with the reason `sampled-out`. Omitted: the `mutation.mutantsPerLine`
config key, else no limit.

operators.description:
Kebab-case operator names, for example `relational-operator`.
Omitted: the `mutation.operators` config key, else the default set.
The opt-in operators, such as `block-statement`, run only when named.

package.description:
The Cargo package of a Rust workspace with more than one package.
Valid only on a Rust workspace, where the plan covers the whole package
unless `paths` or `changed_since` is set.

paths.description: Plan only these files or directories, relative to the root.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

name: mutation_plan
